units: <cite ref="Berakhot 6b">Ber. 6ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 30b:3">Sabb. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>לִצְווֹת לזה</he> ed. (perh. fr. <cite ref="R00262"><he>צָוַת</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="R00262"><he>צוּת</he></cite>; Ar. <he>לצבות</he>), v. <cite ref="R00071"><he>צָבַת</he></cite>.—[
<cite ref="Menachot 44a:7">Men. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>מצוה אחת צִיוָּנוּ וכ׳</he> the Lord gave us one command, its name is Tsitsith.
<cite ref="Menachot 44a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>צַוֵּה עלי ויעשוני וכ׳</he> give orders about me, that they make me a proselyte.

<cite ref="Shabbat 23a">Sabb. 23ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אשר קדשנו … וצִוָּנוּ וכ׳</he> (abbrev. <he>אקב״ו</he> who has sanctified us through his commandments, and commanded us to &c.; <he>והיכן צִוָּנוּ</he> and where did he command us (where in the Torah is it intimated)? <cite ref="Bava Batra 151b:12">B. Bath. 151ᵇ</cite> <he>מְצַוֶּה מחמת מיתה</he> one who disposes of his property, because he expects to die. Sifra Tsav, end <he>כדי המְצַוֶּה למי שנצטוה</he> the commander was worthy of him who was commanded; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְצוּוֶּה</he>.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 31a:11">Kidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>גדול מצ׳ ועושה וכ׳</he> he who is commanded, and does (a good deed, because it is God’s will) stands higher than he that is not commanded and does (a good deed); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be ordered, commanded. Ib. 38ᵃ שלש מצות נִצְטַוּוּ וכ׳ three commands were given to the lsraelites on their entering the land. Ib. 38ᵇ כל מצוה שנצטוו וכ׳ whatever command was enjoined upon the Israelites before they entered the land. Y. Meg. I, 70ᵈ bot. אלו המצות שנִצְטַוִּינוּ וכ׳ these are the commandments which were given us through the mouth of Moses; a. fr.
